statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r equals (if nums[0] = 0 then 1 else 0) plus the number of indices i with 1 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] != nums[i-1]. For len(nums) = 1 the number of such i is 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: The function returns Result.ok r for some r; it does not fail.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 1 - nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(nums) - nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r mod 2 = 1 - nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Let nums2 be the array of length len(nums)+1 with nums2[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums2[len(nums)] = b. Whenever min_operations(nums) returns Result.ok r and min_operations(nums2) returns Result.ok r2, r2 = r + 1 if b != nums[len(nums)-1], and r2 = r if b = nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) < 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1; b is either 0 or 1.

statement: Let nums2 be the array of length len(nums)+1 with nums2[0] = 1 and nums2[i+1] = nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever min_operations(nums) returns Result.ok r and min_operations(nums2) returns Result.ok r2, r2 = r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) < 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is nonnegative and there exists a finite sequence of exactly r indices i_1, ..., i_r, each satisfying 0 <= i_k < len(nums), such that starting from nums and successively flipping, for k = 1, ..., r, all elements with index at least i_k, the resulting array has every element equal to 1. If r = 0 this is the empty sequence.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.

statement: Let nums2 be the array of the same length as nums with nums2[j] = 1 - nums[j] for every j with i <= j < len(nums), and nums2[j] = nums[j] for every j with 0 <= j < i. Whenever min_operations(nums) returns Result.ok r and min_operations(nums2) returns Result.ok r2, either r2 = r + 1 or r2 = r - 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1; 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns Result.ok r, for every finite sequence of indices i_1, ..., i_k with k < r and each 0 <= i_j < len(nums), starting from nums and successively flipping, for j = 1, ..., k, all elements with index at least i_j, the resulting array is not all ones.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] is either 0 or 1.
